|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-D-darthmaullonehunter.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V3-D-darthmaullonehunter-2022-12-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V3-D-darthmaullonehunter-2020-05-12.gif]], 12 May 2020) → [[File:V3-D-darthmaullonehunter-2022-12-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V3-D-darthmaullonehunter.gif]], 1 December 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Darth Maul, Lone Hunter]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-darthmaullonehunter022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/darthmaullonehunter.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Dark/large/darthmaullonehunter.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•If The Trace Was Correct”. Text: “Cancels the game text of Amidala, Obi-Wan, and Qui-Gon at same site. While alone, Blaster Deflection is canceled here and Maul's weapon destiny draws may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Darth Maul, Lone Hunter (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 May 2020<ref name="img-darthmaullonehuntera5142dd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/darthmaullonehunter.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 commit a5142dd] (12 May 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Dark/large/darthmaullonehunter.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' deploy 7 → 6; “Cancels the” → “If drawn for destiny, may take into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Cancels Blaster”; “Cancels the game text of Amidala, Obi-Wan, and Qui-Gon at same site. While alone, Blaster Deflection” → “destiny. Cancels Blaster Deflection”; “Blaster Deflection is canceled here and Maul's weapon” → “Blaster Deflection (and Amidala's game text) here. Maul's weapon”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•If The Trace Was Correct” → “If The Trace Was Correct” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “If The Trace Was Correct”. Text: “If drawn for destiny, may take into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Cancels Blaster Deflection (and Amidala's game text) here. Maul's weapon destiny draws may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Immune to attrition < 5.”
